en: The postcard displays an old, sepia-toned photograph of stone ruins nestled in a wooded area. The structure appears to be made of large, weathered blocks with arches and partial wall remains, indicating it was once a significant building, possibly medieval. There is a wrought iron or wooden gate in an archway and partial stone staircases visible, surrounded by large trees casting shadows across the ruins.
